CITY OF SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL AGENDA Steve Talt, Mayor www.CityofSanMarino.org Steven W. Huang, DDS, Vice Mayor (626) 300­0700 Phone Tony Chou, Council Member City Hall Council Chamber Calvin Lo, Council Member 2200 Huntington Drive Gretchen Shepherd Romey, Council Member San Marino, CA 91108 Mario Rueda, Acting City Manager ADJOURNED REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN MARINO CITY COUNCIL FRIDAY, FEBRUARY 24, 2023 AT 9:30 AM BARTH ROOM CROWELL PUBLIC LIBRARY 1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE SAN MARINO, CA 91108 The City of San Marino appreciates your attendance. Citizens’ interest provides the Council with valuable information regarding issues of the community. Regular meetings are held on the 2nd Wednesday of every month at 6:00 p.m. Typically, adjourned meetings are held on the last Friday of every month at 8:30 a.m. In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who requires a reasonable modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City Clerk via email at CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org or by phone at (626) 300­0705 prior to the meeting for assistance. PURSUANT TO ASSEMBLY BILL 361 (AB 361) Members of the City Council may teleconference into the meeting without noticing each teleconference location from which a member will be participating in a public meeting. CORONAVIRUS DISEASE (COVID­19) ADVISORY To protect both staff, our constituents, and elected officials, it is recommended that members of the public wear a mask indoors, per the State and County Health Department’s current Health Officer Orders. Given the seriousness of COVID­19, you are encouraged to provide input electronically if you do not feel comfortable attending in person. How to view or listen to the meeting from home: 1. Public comment will be accepted by email to CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org until 3:00 p.m. the day before the meeting, to be read by the City Clerk during public comment. Lengthy public comment may be summarized in the interest of time. Any comments received after 3:00 p.m. will be included in the public comment record but will not be read at the meeting. 2. Public comment will be accepted electronically via the zoom.us teleconference module during the meeting. Zoom comments will be taken after the in­person comments. CALL TO ORDER PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE ROLL CALL Council Member Chou, Council Member Lo, Council Member Shepherd Romey, Vice Mayor Huang, and Mayor Talt POSTING OF AGENDA The agenda is posted 72 hours prior to each meeting at the following locations: City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive, the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive, and the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive. The agenda is also posted on the City’s website: http://www.cityofsanmarino.org. PUBLIC COMMENTS The City welcomes public input. Members of the public may address the City Council by completing a public comment card and giving it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting. At this time, the public may address the City Council on items that are not on the agenda. Pursuant to state law, the City Council may not discuss or take action on issues not on the meeting agenda (Government Code Section 54954.2). The Mayor reserves the right to place limits on duration of comments. Staff may be asked to follow up on such items. PRESENTATION 1. PRESENTATION OF CITY TILE TO BRANDON TSAY CONTINUED BUSINESS 2. FY 2023­24 PRIORITY INITIATIVES PROPOSALS Recommendation: Staff recommends that the City Council engage in a discussion and give direction on which priority initiatives they would like staff to incorporate into the City’s Fiscal Year 2023­24 work plan and budget. NEW BUSINESS 3. UPDATE ON DEI TASK FORCE RECOMMENDATIONS Recommendation: Staff recommends the City Council receive and file the DEI Task Force Initiative Update. 4. CONSIDERATION OF RESOLUTION NO. R­23­08 PROCLAIMING THE TERMINATION OF THE LOCAL EMERGENCY CONCERNING THE COVID­19 VIRUS Recommendation: Staff recommends the Council adopt Resolution No. R­23­08. If the Council concurs with staff’s recommendation, an appropriate motion would be:

”I move to adopt Resolution No. R­23­08, a Resolution of the City Council of the City of San Marino, California, Proclaiming the Termination of the Local Emergency Concerning the COVID­19 Virus.” WRITTEN COMMUNICATIONS OR PUBLIC WRITINGS DISTRIBUTION This is an opportunity to announce any written communications pertaining to the City received by members of the City Council. All public writings distributed by the City of San Marino to at least a majority of the City Council regarding any item on this agenda will be made available at the Public Counter at City Hall located at 2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108, and will also be included in the public agenda packet that will available for review at the City Council meeting. PUBLIC COMMENTS FUTURE AGENDA ITEMS ADJOURNMENT Posted: February 17, 2023 CHRISTINA BAKER CITY CLERK AGENDA – FEBRUARY 24, 2023 PAGE 3 of 3 聖馬力諾 市議會議程 Steve Talt，市長 www.CityofSanMarino.org Steven W. Huang，牙外科博士，副市長 電話：(626) 300-0700 Tony Chou，市議員 市政廳市議會會議室 Calvin Lo，市議員 2200 Huntington Drive Gretchen Shepherd Romey，市議員 San Marino, CA 91108 Mario Rueda，代理市政府執行長 聖馬力諾 市議會 於 2023 年 2 月 24 日（星期五）上午 9:30 在 CROWELL 公共圖書館 BARTH ROOM 舉行延期例會，地址：1890 HUNTINGTON DRIVE SAN MARINO, CA 91108。 聖馬力諾市政府感謝您出席會議。公民參與為市議會提供了有關社區問題的寶貴資訊。 每個月的第二個星期三下午 6 時舉行例會。通常，延期舉行的會議在每個月的最後一個星期五上午 8:30 舉行。 根據《美國殘障人士法》，任何需要合理照顧或便利以參加會議的殘障人士應在會議前與市書記官聯繋， 請求協助，電子郵件：CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org；電話：(626) 300-0705。 根據加州衆議院第 361 號法案（AB 361） 市議員可以透過電話參加會議，而無需告知其參加公衆會議的所在地點。 新冠病毒疾病（COVID-19）通告 為了保護工作人員、我們的選民和民選官員，建議公眾按照州和縣衛生部當前衛生官員的命令在室內戴口 罩。鑒於新冠病毒疾病的嚴重性，如果您覺得親自出席不方便，我們鼓勵您透過電子方式提出意見。 議程 — 2023 年 2 月 24 日 第1頁/共4頁 如何在家觀看或收聽會議： 透過電腦接收視訊串流： 網站：https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83331448957 會議代碼：833 3144 8957 透過電話僅接收音訊： 電話號碼：(669) 900-9128 會議代碼：833 3144 8957 如何在家中發表公衆評議： 公衆可使用電郵提出意見：CityClerk@CityofSanMarino.org，截止時間是會議前一天下午 3 時，由市 書記官在公眾評議發表期間宣讀。為了節省時間，可能會對冗長的公眾評議進行總結。下午 3 時後收到的 任何評議都將包括在公眾評議紀錄中，但不會在會議上宣讀。 會議期間提出的公眾評議將透過 zoom.us 電話會議模塊以電子方式接受。透過 Zoom 提出的評議將在現 場評議發表之後接受。 宣佈開會 宣誓效忠美國 點名 市議員 Chou、市議員 Lo、市議員 Shepherd Romey、副市長 Huang 和市長 Talt 議程發佈 議程會在每次會議前 72 小時於以下地點發佈：City Hall, 2200 Huntington Drive；the Crowell Public Library, 1890 Huntington Drive；the Stoneman Building, 1560 Pasqualito Drive。議程 還將在市政府網站上發佈：http://www.cityofsanmarino.org。 公衆評議 市政府歡迎公衆提出意見。公眾可以填寫公眾評議卡，並在會議舉行前將其交給市書記官，由市書記官轉 交給市議會。此時，公眾可以就未列入會議議程的事項向市議會提出意見。根據州法，市議會不得討論未 列入會議議程的事項或就這些事項採取行動（《政府法典》第 54954.2 節）。市長保留限制評議時間的 權利。工作人員可能會按照指示對此類事項採取跟進措施。 頒發獎牌 1. 向 BRANDON TSAY 頒發市政府獎牌。 議程 — 2023 年 2 月 24 日 第2頁/共4頁 持續業務 2. 2023-2024 財年優先計劃提案 建議：工作人員建議市議會參與討論，並就他們希望工作人員將哪些優先計劃納入本市 2023- 2024 財年工作計劃和預算給予指導。 新議題 3. 多元化、公平性與包容性（DEI）特別工作組建議更新 建議：工作人員建議市議會接收並提交 DEI 特別工作組計劃更新。 4. 考慮 宣佈終止與新冠病毒相關的地方緊急狀態的第 R-23-08 號決議 建議：工作人員建議市議會采納第 R-23-08 號決議。如果市議會同意工作人員的建議，則適當的 動議將是：

「我提議採納加州聖馬力諾市議會的第 R-23-08 號決議，宣佈終止與新冠 病毒相關的地方緊急狀態。」 書面通訊或公開文件分發 這是公佈市議員收到的與市政府有關的任何書面通訊的機會。聖馬力諾市政府向至少大多數市議員分發的 關於本議程任何討論事項的所有公開文件將在市政廳公衆服務臺供公眾查閲，市政廳地址：2200 Huntington Drive, San Marino, California 91108；並將包括在公共議程文件夾中，可在市議會開會 期間審閲。 公衆評議 未來議程討論事項 休會 發佈日期：2023 年 2 月 17 日 CHRISTINA BAKER 市書記官 議程 — 2023 年 2 月 24 日 第4頁/共4頁
